method.capability_definition: qb-OR-classifier, >=2 jobs for rule basket. CORRECTION 3: single bidirectional op-name reclassification scoped to Embellishment/Hard Cover Books/Soft Cover Books — celloglaze/film/laser/fuse->Specialty, perfect-bind/saddle->Soft Cover, foil/deboss reclaimed->Embellishment, casebinding reclaimed->Hard Cover; genuine casebinding-only kept in Hard Cover. The other 6 capabilities untouched.
method.candidate_pick: single best genuine-0-order-gap pitch by confidence x lift
method.embellishment_finish_gate: standalone-Embellishment pitch suppressed when the company already applies >=2 qb_embellishment_tag finish jobs (Hot Foil/Spot UV/Deboss...). Signal-3 check beyond the 0-order gap-confirm — the Geoff Letchford trap; validated in cards_validation.json.
method.timing: percentile-of-own-gaps (p50/p90 of the customer's own inter-order gaps) + seasonality + email recency
method.opportunity_strength: base(conf*lift | RET_CONST) x log10(revenue) x timing_factor
method.revenue_weight: log10(revenue) — DAMPENED so conf/lift/timing can move the rank (raw revenue stored in factors.revenue for a raw re-rank)
method.selection: all 2174 companies ranked by prelim opportunity; top 120 email-grounded; final top 50
method.confidence_semantics: confidence on each card = best single-antecedent rule P(Y|X) where X is the basket item that most strongly predicts the gap Y (not full-basket-conditioned P(Y|all basket items), which is too sparse). Card text states it plainly: 'customers who buy X also buy Y'.

honesty_guards: Confidence is the real rule % (P(Y|X)), never rounded up or relabelled.
Every pitch verified as a genuine 0-order gap at company grain under qb-OR-classifier (back.pitch_evidence.gap_confirmation).
No archetype / no AM comparison / no scorecard in any front or back field.
Deferred QB-conflict companies flagged (conflict_flag + data_quality); unresolved ones sunk in ranking.
caveats: PROVISIONAL card set (per task 11.1): final once mailbox data is complete.

Email recency/timing for Ehab-managed accounts may be UNDERSTATED — Ehab mailbox is ~2 weeks unsynced (DATA_ANALYSIS_GUIDELINES s0.3); a stale-looking recency on his accounts can be a sync gap, not silence.
Email-recency factor is computed only for the 120-company email-grounded pool the final 50 are drawn from; prelim ranking over all companies uses order-rhythm timing without email recency.

Revenue weight = log10(revenue), a deliberate dampening of the literal 'x customer revenue' so conf/lift/timing can move the ranking; raw revenue + all four factors are on every card (factors.*) for a raw-revenue re-rank.

Pitches cluster on Embellishment + Wide Format because those are the strongest high-confidence consequents of the books/display capabilities — a real structural finding in the 8-item capability space, not noise.

Standalone-Embellishment pitches are gated on signal-3 finishes (qb_embellishment_tag): suppressed when the company already applies >=2 finish jobs. In validation (cards_validation.json) this caught the Geoff Letchford trap; 9 heavy-embellisher cards were repitched or downgraded, 8 marginal (1-finish) kept.
Two-way engagement requires BOTH inbound>=3 and outbound>=3; a purely inbound contact is not counted as engaged.
